sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. The leaders are looking to bounce back immediately after their most recent loss, though their underlying form remains strong with four wins in their last five outings. Alsager arrive at the bottom of the division with just 4 points and a run of five losses in their last six games, making them heavy underdogs in this contest.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a tough test away at Dawley Town on Saturday—Stafford are just two points behind the leaders but come into the fixture having lost their last two games, while Dawley are in mid-table and seeking consistency. AFC Bridgnorth, third in the table, host Eccleshall in a fixture between two of the division's stronger teams; Bridgnorth have recovered from recent losses with improved form. Wolverhampton Casuals travel to Wednesfield Community looking to build on their recent winning streak, while Bilston Town (sixth) head to Foley Meir seeking to maintain their strong position. Barnton, unbeaten in their last two, welcome Shawbury United, who are in severe form trouble with six consecutive losses. Market Drayton Town host New Mills in a mid-table contest, while Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Crewe in a clash between struggling sides. Brereton Social are at home to Widnes Town, who remain rooted to the bottom with just 2 points from 7 games.
